anomalies.description: A soldier in a helmet and olive uniform is shown aiming and firing a bazooka (shoulder-fired rocket launcher) from a crouched position behind rubble; muzzle flash and recoil are visible across frames f4–f7.

A soldier in a helmet and olive uniform is shown aiming a bazooka (shoulder-fired rocket launcher) directly forward, with his finger on the trigger and body braced for recoil; this constitutes visual evidence of an imminent or ongoing shooting action.

A large, sudden fireball erupts from the German tank (number 107) at 10.0 s, indicating a direct hit and detonation; the explosion is fully developed by 10.5 s with intense flames and debris ejection.

A large explosion erupts from the German tank (number 107), engulfing it in fire and smoke; the blast is visible across multiple frames as the fire intensifies and spreads.; A large, bright orange fireball erupts from the top of a military vehicle (likely a tank or armored personnel carrier), indicating a violent explosion. Debris is visible around the vehicle.

At the moment of explosion (f4–f5), a muzzle flash and projectile trajectory are visible emanating from the soldier’s weapon (a Panzerschreck) toward the tank, indicating a direct hit just before or concurrent with detonation.
